headline: Public comment on proposed projects at 11 Lojko Drive, L Pine Street, 1 Pine Street Extension, and 5 Stockton Drive.
summary: Three proposals are open to public comment, including a dog park with 8 parking spaces. The NIMCO site and the Nashua Public Library are listed as informational only.
items: Public dog park on L Pine Street (City of Nashua)
Two 5-story multi-family residential buildings at 1 Pine Street Extension (NIMCO)
Deck replacement at 5 Stockton Drive (Berman Revocable Trust)
Partial demolition and renovation of Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street
Correspondence from Jarrod William about falcons and a tree swallow at L Pine Street
location: Room 208, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH
plain_text:
Next Regular Meeting: January 5, 2026 
 
 
City of Nashua 
Conservation Commission 
City Hall, 229 Main Street, PO Box 2019, Nashua NH 03061-2019 
(603) 589-3090         www.nashuanh.gov 
 
NASHUA CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Meeting of the City of Nashua Conservation Commission will occur in Room 
208 at the Nashua City Hall located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH on December 1, 2026 at 7pm. 
A. Call to Order 
B. Roll Call  
C. Approval of Minutes 
11/04/2026 NCC Regular Meeting 
11/18/2026 11 Lojko Dr Site Walk 
11/23/2026 L Pine St Site Walk 
 
D. Old Business - Public Comment Related to this Item (Limited to 3 Minutes per Speaker) 
 
Christine Sheridan, 11 Lojko Drive. Proposal to install a 20’ x 36’ inground, gunite swimming pool 
within the wetland buffer of a critical wetland, with permanent impact to 572 SF of the wetland buffer. 
Map B. Lot 2818. Zone R-18 B – Suburban Residence. Ward 9. 
 
City of Nashua, L Pine Street. Proposal to develop a public dog park, including 8 parking spaces, 
with permanent impact to 12,975 SF of the wetland buffer for a prime wetland. Map 77. Lot 5. Zone 
R-B – Urban Residence. Ward 4. 
 
City of Nashua, 1 Pine Street Extension (NIMCO). Proposal to redevelop this site by constructing 
2 5-story, multi-family residential buildings, including new roads, sidewalks, surface parking and 
understructure parking at both buildings. Map 77. Lot 30. Zone GI/MU – General Industrial/Mixed 
Use. Ward 4. Subject to Shoreland Urban Exemption – Informational Only (No Vote). 
 
E. New Business - Public Comment Related to this Item (Limited to 3 Minutes per Speaker) 
 
Berman Revocable Trust, Richard C. Berman and Eliot J. Berman Trustees, 5 Stockton Drive. 
Proposal to replace an existing deck with a new deck of the same footprint including the addition of 
concrete  footings to meet building code standards with temporary and permanent impact to the 
wetland buffer for a for a wetland greater than 9000 SF. Map F. Lot 32. Zone R-18 – Suburban 
Residence. Ward 1. 
 
City of Nashua, 2 Court Street (Nashua Public Library). Proposal to partially demolish, redevelop 
and renovate the library building located on a 2.92 acre site adjacent to the Nashua River. Map 33. 
Lots 44 and 104. Zone D1/MU – Downtown 1/ Mixed Use. Map 34. Lot 2. Zone R-C – Urban 
Residence. Ward 4. Subject to Shoreland Urban Exemption – Informational Only (No Vote). 
 
F. NCC Correspondence and Communications 
 
1. Jarrod William – Falcons and tree swallow at L Pine Street. 
2. Other.

1. Other.

K. Adjournment
